title: Metaphor: ReFantazio
provenance: CrossOver users show it running on Apple Silicon (a CrossOver 26 video on an M4 Mac mini with an audio fix, a CrossOver 24 report on macOS 15 reaching an early save); on Highball it crashed at launch for one reporter (highball#80, M5 Max, macOS 26.5.2, Highball 0.8.8, engine r0, DXMT, AVX not advertised). Not verified by Highball.
notes: DirectX 11, Denuvo. The one Highball report is a crash inside the game's own code seconds after launch with AVX not advertised to the game (Highball's default): the crash sits in a fresh thread with nothing on its stack, the shape an anti-tamper or CPU-feature check produces. The recipe advertises AVX the way the Cyberpunk 2077 recipe does, which is the first thing to try; DXMT for the graphics. CrossOver users report the sound cutting out and a fix for it; not looked at here. Free Prologue Demo (Steam 3130330, 64 GB) reproduces the launch path.

knownIssues.symptom: Crash within seconds of launch, page fault in the game's own code, before any window
knownIssues.cause: assumed, not measured: AVX hidden from the game under Rosetta (Highball's default), which the game or its anti-tamper does not tolerate
knownIssues.fix: the recipe sets ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1 (same as the Advertise AVX switch in the environment settings); report back if it still crashes with it on
